description: This file contains system and hardware initialization routines for the NXP LPC54114 platform, including clock setup, peripheral initialization, and secondary core boot procedures.

methods.name: clock_init
methods.description: Initializes system clocks for the LPC54114 platform, setting up clock sources, dividers, and peripheral clocks.

methods.name: nxp_lpc54114_init
methods.description: Performs basic hardware initialization, including clock setup and peripheral initialization.

methods.name: z_arm_platform_init
methods.description: Platform-specific initialization routine for the Cortex-M0 core, calling SystemInit.

methods.name: _slave_init
methods.description: Boots the secondary Cortex-M0 core by copying its image to SRAM and setting up boot parameters.
